movelist.name: Aurora Beam
movelist.effect: Aurora Beam lowers the target’s Attack 1 Combat Stage on 18+.

movelist.name: Feather Dance
movelist.effect: All legal targets have their Attack lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Defog
movelist.effect: The Weather becomes Clear, and all Blessings, Coats, and Hazards are destroyed. Clear Weather is the default weather, conferring no innate bonuses or penalties of any sort.

movelist.name: Mist
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Mist may activate it when having Combat Stages lowered by any effect; if they do, those Combat Stages are instead not lowered. Mist may be activated 3 times, and then disappears.

movelist.name: Infestation
movelist.effect: The target is put in a Vortex.

abilities.name: Shield Dust
abilities.effect: The user ignores the secondary effects that trigger during Accuracy Roll of damaging Moves that target the user. For example, Flamethrower can never inflict the Burn Condition. Defensive.

abilities.name: Ice Shield
abilities.effect: The user places up to 3 segments of Ice Wall; each segment must be continuous with another segment, and at least one must be adjacent to the user. These Ice Walls count as Blocking Terrain and last until the end of the encounter or until they are destroyed. Each Ice Wall segment is 2 meters tall, 1 meter wide, and 2 centimeters thick. Each segment has 10 Hit Points, 5 Damage Reduction, and takes damage as if it was Ice- Type.
